optionalFeatures: SAVE_AS persistence when the imported workbook should be kept separately.
Post-import factual rereads or exports for verification.
outcomes: Mapped workbook metadata is discovered before any XML payload is pushed in.
Existing mappings can be exported for inspection or diffing.
XML payloads can be imported back through the existing workbook mapping.
requiredInputs: XML payload source when the workbook should be updated.
stdout.summary: Inspect, export, and import existing workbook custom-XML mappings on mapped .xlsx files.

commonPitfalls: IMPORT_CUSTOM_XML_MAPPING requires an existing mapping; discovery comes first.
Large XML payloads belong in UTF8_FILE or STANDARD_INPUT sources instead of huge inline JSON.
Mapped workbook structure is workbook-specific, so replace placeholder mapping locators before execution.

phases.label: Discover Existing Mappings
notes: Map discovery tells you which locator to target.
phases.objective: Read the workbook mapping metadata before attempting export or import.

phases.label: Import Updated XML
notes: Use SAVE_AS when you want to preserve the original workbook.
phases.objective: Push one XML payload through the chosen existing mapping.

phases.label: Verify The Result
notes: Post-import export is the fastest proof that the mapping changed.
phases.objective: Re-export or reread workbook facts after the import.
